title: Page attachments
intro: Add and review files for this page. This is separate from saving its text.
checking: Reviewing the page and upload state…
reviewed: The current state has been reviewed.
preparing: Preparing the file on this device…
prepared: Ready for review. Confirm the file and its destination before sending.
name: File name
limit: Up to 16 MiB per file. Files stay in this tab until you confirm sending.
uploadTitle: Attach this file to this page?
uploadConsent: Send the displayed file to this server and attach it to this page after verification. Current page permissions apply.
memoryOnly: The original file stays only in this tab. After reloading, you can review the state already saved on the server.
downloadHint: Files download without an embedded preview. Current page access is checked when downloading.
deleteHint: Remove the attachment from this page and delete its file. This cannot be undone. Any links in the text will no longer open.
pendingHint: Only uploads prepared by the current account for this page appear here. Review uploaded files before attaching them, or resume unfinished cancellation.
bindTitle: Attach the uploaded file to this page?
bindHint: Attach this file already held on the server. No new file will be sent.
cancelPendingHint: Delete the file prepared for this page. If cancellation fails, review its state before resuming.
attached: The file is confirmed as attached to this page.
discardHint: Release the file held in this tab. Files already sent to the server remain. Review or cancel them individually in the unfinished list.
discarded: The local file selection was discarded.
leaveHint: The file held in this tab will be lost. Unfinished server uploads remain and can be reviewed from this page.
disabled: Attachment storage is unavailable on this server.
accountChanged: The signed-in account changed or expired. The file is retained and sending has stopped.
accessChanged: Access to change attachments on this page could not be confirmed. The retained file will not be sent.
heldAccount: Your selected file remains in this tab. Sign in as the original account and review the state, or explicitly discard the selection.
conflict: Saved content changed. The file is retained and sending has stopped. Review server state before choosing the next action.
reviewConflict: Saved content changed during review. Sending has stopped. Review the state again.
missingResult: The upload result cannot be confirmed. The file is retained and a new upload will not be created. Review server state.
uncertain: The result could not be confirmed. The file is retained and automatic retries are stopped. Review server state.
savedReviewFailed: Saving the operation was confirmed, but the latest list could not be loaded. Review server state before continuing.
tooLarge: Choose a file of 16 MiB or less.
invalidFile: The file name or format could not be validated. Choose a file with a safe name.
invalidRoute: The destination workspace and page are invalid. Open attachments from a page.
signIn: Sign in with a verified account
boundary: Attachment actions apply only to this page. They do not replace its text, other pages or notes on this device.
accountsDisabled: Accounts are unavailable on this server.
contentDisabled: Workspace content is unavailable on this server.
localeFallbackNotice: Some labels use English. Page names and content are not translated.
